hook_title: The Global Crush vs Local Gravy

beats.action: Wei sets down a heavy bowl of mashed potatoes while Lin scrolls her phone.

dialogue.speaker: Wei
dialogue.text: I didn't realize Netflix's Number One Body was coming to dinner.

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.text: I'm just studying his discipline, Wei. It's very inspiring content.

beats.action: Wei leans over to see the screen which shows a shredded athlete.

dialogue.speaker: Wei
dialogue.text: Is the discipline located entirely in his shirtless beach workout scenes?

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.text: The cinematography really highlights the structural integrity of his abs.

beats.action: Wei stands up straight and tries to subtly flex his arms while holding a platter.

dialogue.speaker: Wei
dialogue.text: I also have structural integrity from carrying this entire turkey platter.

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.text: Jeremiah Trotter has speed, but you have... excellent gravy-to-potato ratios.

beats.action: Wei stops mid-flex and looks at the potatoes then back at Lin.

dialogue.speaker: Wei
dialogue.text: Are you saying my best physical attribute is seasonal vegetable management?

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.text: Exactly. He's for the global charts, but you’re my local hero.

beats.action: Wei sits down and starts piling food onto Lin's plate with a smirk.

dialogue.speaker: Wei
dialogue.text: I guess being the Number One Couch Body has its perks.

music_prompt: A warm, bouncy lo-fi hip hop track with a cozy acoustic guitar melody and festive bells in the background.
caption: When your Thanksgiving glow-up is competing with the Netflix Global Number One. 🦃📺

history_entry.hook: The Global Crush vs Local Gravy
history_entry.core_joke: Lin defends her celebrity crush as 'studying discipline' while Wei tries to compete with his turkey-carrying skills.
